come.jaymoskingdoms.hurt.0: Look at you, you're cut to ribbons. Here, eat something, and sit before you fall down.
come.jaymoskingdoms.hurt.1: Gods, you're hurt. Take this bread, and get those wounds seen to.
come.jaymoskingdoms.hurt.2: You're limping and pale as milk. Eat. You'll do no one any good dead.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.hurt.0: You walked past bleeding like a stuck pig. I wasn't going to just stand and watch.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.hurt.1: You looked half dead, that's what. A body doesn't walk on by when someone's hurt like that.
come.jaymoskingdoms.gist.hurt: They point at your wounds, wince, and press bread into your hands.

come.jaymoskingdoms.why.danger.0: That %1$s. It was creeping up on you and you hadn't a clue. I'd want someone to tell me.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.danger.1: You'd have walked right into that %1$s. Couldn't let that happen in front of my own door.
come.jaymoskingdoms.gist.danger: They point hard to the %2$s, eyes wide, and mime claws. There's something there: a %1$s.
come.jaymoskingdoms.hail.storm.1: Ho there! You'll want a roof!
come.jaymoskingdoms.storm.0: You'll be soaked through out here. There's shelter under the eaves, and a fire if you knock.
come.jaymoskingdoms.storm.1: Rain like this turns the roads to soup. Get under cover a while, you won't get far.
come.jaymoskingdoms.storm.2: Sky's black as a crow. If the lightning's coming, you don't want to be the tallest thing in the field.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.storm.0: You were standing out in the rain like a lost sheep. Seemed only right to say something.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.storm.1: Folk die of chills, you know. Weather like this, we look out for whoever's caught in it.
come.jaymoskingdoms.gist.storm: They hold a hand up to the rain, shake their head, and wave you toward the nearest roof.
come.jaymoskingdoms.thanks.0: I've been hoping I'd see you again.
come.jaymoskingdoms.thanks.1: I never got to say it properly.
come.jaymoskingdoms.thanks.2: Please, a moment. I owe you a word.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.thanks.0: What you did for me. I'd have hated myself if I'd let you pass without a word of thanks.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.thanks.1: Some things you say to a face, not a back. I'd been carrying it since.
come.jaymoskingdoms.gist.thanks: They take your hand in both of theirs and squeeze it, nodding, eyes bright. They're grateful for something.
come.jaymoskingdoms.deed.0: You're the one everyone's talking about. I had to see for myself.
come.jaymoskingdoms.deed.1: So you're the one. The whole place has been on about you.
come.jaymoskingdoms.deed.2: I hoped it was you. Folk here won't stop telling of it.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.deed.0: Word's gone round about what you did. When I saw you I couldn't just go on hoeing.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.deed.1: It's not every day you meet someone folk tell stories about. I wanted to shake your hand.
come.jaymoskingdoms.gist.deed: They point at you, then back at the village, grinning, and mime a crowd clapping.
come.jaymoskingdoms.kin.0: You're %1$s, aren't you? I can always tell. You don't see many of us out this way.
come.jaymoskingdoms.kin.1: %1$s blood, here! I thought I was the only one for days around.
come.jaymoskingdoms.kin.2: I knew it from across the square. %1$s, same as me. Where are your people from?
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.kin.0: There's so few %1$s about. Seeing one of my own blood, I just had to come and say hello.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.kin.1: When you're the only %1$s in a place, you notice the next one. It's like hearing your own tongue.
come.jaymoskingdoms.gist.kin: They touch their own face, then point at yours, beaming. They see you're %1$s, like them.
come.jaymoskingdoms.foreign.0: Where are you from, then? You don't sound like anyone from round here.
come.jaymoskingdoms.foreign.1: A real foreigner! Say something in your own tongue, go on.
come.jaymoskingdoms.foreign.2: You've come a long way, haven't you? I can see it on you.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.foreign.0: You're plainly not from here. We don't get many, and I was curious, that's all.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.foreign.1: Strangers from far off are the most interesting thing to happen here all season.
come.jaymoskingdoms.gist.foreign: They point at you, then far away, and spread their hands with a curious tilt of the head: where from?

come.jaymoskingdoms.gear.1: Now that's a %1$s. Does it turn a blade? It looks like it would.

come.jaymoskingdoms.why.gear.0: Your %1$s caught my eye from across the way. I've a weakness for good gear.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.gear.1: It's not often a %1$s like that walks past. I wanted a proper look.
come.jaymoskingdoms.gist.gear: They point at your %1$s and whistle, tapping it with a knuckle.
come.jaymoskingdoms.beast.0: Have you heard? There's something big out there.

come.jaymoskingdoms.beast.2: You'll want to hear this before you go anywhere.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.beast.0: You're heading out into the wilds, aren't you? I'd want to know what's out there, if it were me.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.beast.1: Travellers ought to be warned. Nobody warned the last one, and he never came back.
come.jaymoskingdoms.gist.beast: They point out to the wilds, spread their arms wide, and bare their teeth: something big is out there.
come.jaymoskingdoms.mistaken.0: Oh! I'm so sorry, from behind I'd have sworn you were my cousin.
come.jaymoskingdoms.mistaken.1: Ah. You're not who I thought you were at all. Well, hello anyway.
come.jaymoskingdoms.mistaken.2: Oh, how embarrassing. I took you for an old friend. I've run all this way, too.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.mistaken.0: I took you for someone else, from a distance. Silly of me. Still, now we've met.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.mistaken.1: You walk just like my cousin. I was halfway over before I saw your face.
come.jaymoskingdoms.gist.mistaken: They stop short, look you up and down, and laugh at themselves, flapping a hand: they took you for someone else.
come.jaymoskingdoms.gist.approach: They wave back the way they came and shrug. Whatever they meant, it's lost on you.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.nothing: Nothing, really. Go on with your day.
